newsitem.title: ITALY: Interpump sees 1997 turnover up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Interpump sees 1997 turnover up 10 pct.

text.p: Italian pump and piston group Interpump sees 1997 turnover rising by around 10 percent, chairman Fulvio Montipo said.
"On the basis of results in the first months of this year we forecast an increase in consolidated turnover of around 10 percent," he told reporters after the company's AGM.
Interpump, which made its debut on the Milan bourse in December, posted 1996 net profit of 14.8 billion lire on net sales of 380.2 billion lire. Gross operating margin was 19.1 percent of turnover.
At 1409 GMT, Interpump shares were up 1.72 percent at 5,200 lire on a slightly firmer stock market.
